Commentary.Commentary: That is it from the game then. 1-1 in this 3-match series and we have a decider, not what many would have hoped for before the ODI series. This big win tips India as the favourites to win the decider but Sri Lanka might just spring a surprise if conditions and luck go their way. Do join us for the third and final ODI from Vizag on Sunday, 17th December, 2017 at 1330 LOCAL (0800 GMT). Meanwhile, a more competitive series is starting Down Under - The Ashes. England need to win or draw the third Test to stay alive in the series and retain the Urn. You can catch action from that game too. Adios! Take Care!

Victorious Indian captain and the MAN OF THE MATCH, ROHIT SHARMA smiles and says winning the game was more important. Praises his team for the comeback. Says he can keep on talking about the batting today. First Shikhar Dhawan for the start and then Shreyas Iyer who did not look nervous at all in his second game. Then praises his bowlers for sticking to their lines and lengths in spite of the dew. On his double hundred today, he says that on the previous two occasions where he hit the double hundreds, he had reached a century around the 38th over. So he kept reminding himself that he can get out only if he throws it away. He aimed to play out the entire 50 overs and accelerate at the right time. On being asked which of these three double tons is his best, he just goes around the question and rates all the three as equally good. The one against Australia for being the series decider, the previous one against Sri Lanka because it came after a long layoff and tonight because India were on a low after that humiliating loss in the first ODI. The team wanted to prove a point and it did. Is happy that his wife was here to support him and says that having family members around in the stadium definitely helps. Stresses again that the team winning was more important. Is confident that the team would do well in Vizag for the third ODI but just wants the players to adapt to the conditions and does not want to relax. On Washington Sundar, he says that he was good and has talent. He has seen Sundar in the Indian T20 League and hopes he learnt a lot tonight. Wishes him all the best for the future.

Sri Lankan captain, THISARA PERERA manages to flash a smile even after this defeat. Says that the bowling did not click, hence they lost. But is quick to say that this is cricket and such things happen. Adds that they will take the positives out of this game and flush out all the negatives. On stopping Rohit Sharma, he says that the Lankans had plan A, B and C but none clicked. Further says that to chase big totals like these, they needed to have a good start at the top and later in the middle as well. Promises to come back hard in the final ODI.

Shikhar Dhawan says that he was happy with his flow of batting. Adds that he would have liked to continue but unfortunately things did not go his way. Says that they thought the wicket would be damp and the ball was coming on a bit slowly but he was confident of playing his shots which helped both him and Rohit Sharma. On his advancing to the faster bowlers, Shikhar says that he did the same to shift the bowlers out of their regular lengths. He admits that those lengths have been troubling him, outside off stump, the fifth or the 6th stump line. On Rohit Sharma, he says that the right-hander took his time initially but then made up for it. Praises him for registering his third double ton and also for his first win as a captain. THIS WAS NOT THE PRESENTATION. It is coming up now...

Plenty of rights for India in this game after the wrongs in Dharamsala. The openers played really well early on, then Shreyas Iyer shrugged off his nerves at number 3 and in the bowling, even with the dew, they were pretty economical. They would have preferred to bowl Sri Lanka out but this is as comprehensive a win as any other.

Amongst the positives for Sri Lanka in this chase, only Asela Gunaratne seemed to show some intent. Mathews seemed happier to be amongst the runs than try and get some motive going. He did manage 111 but those were not of much use.

If this had been a normal run chase, then the partnership between Thirimanne and Mathews, and then the next two would have been efficient. Technically, one look at the scorecard and one would say that the Lankans did well to stay there in the middle - 129 runs for wickets 3-5 in 137 balls. But by then, the required run rate and the chance to win had gone beyond the roof.

When you chase anything as high as 393, you cannot afford to take your time. You need to go for your shots but Sri Lanka could not even start looking for big hits. They were 30/2 in no time and then Thirimanne and Mathews started to play some shots.
Applause. The match ends. India win eventually but that was probably decided in the 45th over of the Indian innings itself. Sri Lanka never looked like being in the chase even for a small period.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended to ensure that Sri Lanka are not bowled out. INDIA WIN BY 141 RUNS.
On middle and off, Suranga looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Again, Iyer is confident and appeals for LBW but does not seem to spot the inside edge.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Around off, Lakmal looks to defend but ends up chopping it to the off side. Iyer appeals for LBW and wants a review but Dhoni just cuts him short. Replays show bat first.
Another bouncer, ducked under again.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler.
Very full on middle, worked through square leg for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through square leg for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. A single taken.

DROPPED! Tough luck for Sundar. He nearly gets a wicket but has been robbed of one. Full on off, Mathews swings it straight to deep mid-wicket where Shikhar Dhawan gets to the ball, but it slips right through his hands and hits him on his thighs and drops down. A single taken.
SIX! Gets something going. Full and outside off, Mathews gets underneath this and sends the ball sailing over long on.
Full on middle, swung over mid-wicket but straight to the man in the deep. Just a single.
A seam-up delivery, on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked to the leg side.

Well, Lakmal is free to throw his bat around now and swings it over mid-wicket. Makes not that sweet a connection and that slows the ball down. Shreyas Iyer comes charging to his left and dives to prevent the boundary. Two runs taken.
Banged in short, pulled through square leg for a single.

SECOND ODI HUNDRED for Mathews. Has worked hard to get here but not quite sure whether he will be entirely happy. No intent, probably because the team got knocked out of the chase pretty early. Still, a hundred is a hundred. He works this to the leg side and sets off for a single. Rohit Sharma gets across to his right but then fumbles and Mathews takes the second. Now he clutches his right leg and is in some discomfort.
Around off, watchfully defended.
WIDE. A harsh call. A bouncer around off, Mathews bails out of the hook shot. Did not look that high to be honest.
Fuller in length, defended to the leg side now.
Back of a length, defended to the off side.
Outside off, draws the batsman forward, this time it is a leg spinner which beats the outside edge. Chahal finishes with figures of 10-0-60-3.
Outside off, shorter in length, Lakmal looks to cut but is beaten by the googly.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single. 98 now...
Full and around off, defended to the leg side.

NOT OUT and a WIDE signalled. Full and down the leg side, Mathews misses his flick and his back foot comes up in the air slightly. Dhoni whips off the bails and appeals but umpire Nandan at square leg is in no mood to get it referred. Eventually he does and the replays show that the foot had come down before the bails could come off.

SIX! Aha! Finally Mathews does something to get closer to his century. Nothing wrong with the ball, a top spinner, Mathews reads it to perfection, gets to the pitch of the ball and swings it straight back over the bowler's head. One hit away from the century now.
Tossed up on middle, Mathews defends this awkwardly to the leg side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, punched towards cover for a single this time. Moves to 91.
A full toss outside off, defended towards mid off. Single not taken.
Full and outside off, off, driven straight back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed through cover for one.
Full and around off, Angelo looks to flick and gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket. A run taken.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Mathews misses his flick.
Very full outside off, driven towards long off for a run.

Outside off, punched off the back foot to long off for a single. Boring game going on for the last so many minutes. KilVish here says that Mathews should score a century and Sri Lanka should declare. Oh brother... effects of Test cricket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid on.
Full on middle, pushed back.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
A full toss outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full on middle, driven straight to mid on.
A short ball, tucked past that man at short backward square leg for a single.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.

Short and outside off, Lakmal cuts it towards point where Manish Pandey gets across but fails to stop it with his right hand. Concedes a single but should India mind? Pandya might as the single is going off his bowling but as far as the game situation is concerned, giving the tail-ender the strike for the next over is not bad.
Fuller again, driven towards mid on this time.
Full on middle, driven straight back.
Flicks this away for a single.
FOUR! He is going for it. Mathews comes down the track and bludgeons it past mid off for a boundary. Moves to 85. Meanwhile, SRI LANKA GO PAST ROHIT SHARMA.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.

OUT! Interesting field placement! Normally we do not see innovative positions like leg gully or short backward square leg but here we have one. Hard to say whether it is a leg gully as the fielder is a bit squarer but whatever it is or wherever he is placed, it is a wicket. Let us say short backward square leg in this case. A short ball, around middle and leg, Dananjaya looks to tuck it around the corner but hits it straight to Rohit Sharma at short backward square leg. Rohit smiles. Nice fielding strategy. Not to smile but to keep that man there.
Stays back and defends it watchfully.
A fine yorker on leg stump, Akila digs it out towards mid-wicket.
Excellent bowling, almost a yorker, on middle and leg, Akila misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Bumrah does not bother appealing.
FOUR! Nicely done. A short ball outside off, Dananjaya arches back and guides it over the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence. Moves to 11 from 13 balls.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now five fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Short ball outside off, Mathews shapes for the pull but leaves it in the end.
Overpitched delivery, hit with a lot of power but straight to the man at mid off.
An extra fielder comes in the cover region.
Angling in appreciably as Mathews tucks it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a length on off, Mathews shuffles a touch and tickles it past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Fullish delivery, Mathews prods forward in defense.

Full length ball, sliding down leg. Dananjaya misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Bumrah starts appealing but bails out as he realizes that the ball will miss the leg stump due to the around the wicket angle.
Sliding down the leg side, Akila aims to play it through but is hit on the thigh pad.
Low full toss outside off, Mathews slices it towards point where the fielder dives to his right but fails to stop it. A run taken.
Uses his feet to the fullish delivery and drives it hard to the man at mid off.
Back of a length delivery around off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, placed to the point region.
BUMRAH returns for a bowl.
Length ball on middle and leg, played with soft hands to mid-wicket for a run and he will retain the strike.
Full length ball outside off, driven with an open bat face to point.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.

Good fielding! On a length on middle and leg, Mathews tucks it through square leg. It is racing towards the fence but Karthik is equal to the task. He sprints to his right and dives full length to stop it. It is referred upstairs and the replays confirm that he is fine.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven crisply to mid off.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
HARDIK PANDYA is back on.
Quicker one, eased off the front foot to covers.
Coming in with the arm, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! Floated around off, Dananjaya makes room, comes down the track and chips it over covers for a delightful boundary.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Clears his front leg and whacks it to long off for a single.
Fullish delivery, tapped to mid on for a single.
Good length ball outside off, caressed off the back foot to covers.

FOUR! Brilliant shot! But perhaps these are coming too late. Knuckle ball from Kumar, on a fuller length and in line of the stumps. Mathews clears his front leg and hammers it over mid on for a one-bounce boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Dananjaya drives this one to covers and takes off. There is an unnecessary throw at the keeper's end but no extra run conceded.
This time Mathews executes the pull nicely to deep square leg for a single.
Ooh... sharp short delivery! Bouncer on middle and leg, Mathews goes for a forehand smash but is early into his shot. The ball hits the bottom part of his bat and dies down on the track.
Full ball on off, Mathews heaves it to wide long on for a single.
Stays leg side of the ball and eases it through mid off to rotate strike.
Floated around off, driven with the spin to covers.
Low full toss on off, clipped straight to the man at mid on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drifting towards the pads, tucked off the front foot to mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

OUT! Number 7 down. Not allowed to have vehicles in opposite directions in a one-way lane. This is just like that. India have built a mountain and it is such that it cannot be scaled by anyone else. Sri Lanka slip further. Full and outside off, Pathirana looks to give the charge and go over mid off but Shikhar Dhawan dives to his right and takes a good catch. Does the 'Thigh-Five' as they call it and smiles. Sri Lanka need another 29 runs to beat Rohit Sharma.
A good short ball from around the wicket, Pathirana looks to pull but is comprehensively beaten.
Banged in short, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Landed around off, Pathirana goes back and takes this from the stumps to guide it to third man for a run.
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run. 5000 ODI runs for Mathews, 10th Sri Lankan to do so.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Works this through mid-wicket for a brace now.
FOUR! Risky but effective. Full on middle, Mathews gets down and sweeps it right from the stump line through square leg for a boundary!
Down the leg side, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Pathirana misses his flick.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, played through point for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, Mathews looks to tuck it around the corner but he misses the line. The ball goes off his pads towards square leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.

OUT! The captain is out of here! Smart work from Dhoni. Chahal tosses this around leg and Perera looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off his pads and Dhoni rushes to his right and takes it. It just seems like a simple catch behind appeal but the umpire raises his finger! Thisara does not bother reviewing and replays show why. The ball has hit the pad and then the glove! Third wicket for Chahal who is standing out for India again.

WIDE. Down the leg side, Thisara looks to leave, then tries to play but misses. The ball hits Dhoni's pads and Mathews wants the single but then sends Perera back as first slip gets across quickly to his right.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Outside off, blasted towards widish long off for a single.

OUR! FETCH THAT! Some way to stary your innings. Tossed up on middle, Perera comes down the track and bludgeons it down the ground. Chahal is just a tad late in getting his hand down and thank God for that. Because had he been a second early, he would have been injured. All the way to the long on fence goes the ball. And to think that did not come from the middle of the bat. More from the bottom part.

OUT! Easy stumping! Chahal gets his man. Sees Gunaratne give him the charge and tosses this slightly slowly and a little bit wider outside off. Gunaratne aims to go inside out and in the process goes too far from the ball. Dhoni collects and before we could say 'Out' the bails are dislodged. End of a promising knock and stand.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Gunaratne brings out the switch hit now and gets it up and over point. No one in the deep. The stand moves to 40 from 45 balls.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! That came out of frustration. Two dot balls on the trot and Mathews avoids a hat-trick. Comes down the track and blasts it over mid off for a boundary.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.

On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. That is 50 number 36 in ODIs for Mathews. Only the Sri Lankan dressing room applauds. Mathews himself does not care. Nice to see. This game is not about personal milestones. Sri Lanka are way behind the 8-ball. 150 up for them and they need another 243 from 125 balls.
Bowls slower through the air, around 75 kph, outside off, Gunaratne defends it watchfully.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Eases this down to long off for a single.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Expensive over! Short and flat outside off, Gunaratne goes back and cuts it hard between short third man and backward point! 12 from the over, all in boundaries! 247 more needed from 132 balls now. The stand moves to 31 from 32 balls.
FOUR! And again! Full and on middle, Gunaratne gets down and picks out another reverse sweep, over point, one bounce and into the ropes!
Quicker ball outside off, Asela looks to cut but misses.

FOUR! FEROCIOUS! Down the leg side, Gunaratne brings out his reverse sweep and gets it JUST over Axar Patel at point! It would have been a catch but Axar anticipates a bit incorrectly, going to his left before realizing that it is coming to his right. Gunaratne moves to 20 from 21 balls. The stand is worth 23 from 29 balls now.
Backs away to the leg side and aims for an inside out shot but finds cover.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and straight, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for one more. 259 more needed from 139 balls.
Down the leg side, flicked to short fine leg where a fumble allows the run.

Nice fielding. Asela telegraphs his intentions to play the reverse sweep and seeing that Chahal fires this down the leg side. However, the batsman adjusts well and gets the shot to perfection, nailing it to point. But Shikhar Dhawan dives to his left and gets a hand to it, partially stopping the ball. Just a single.
Slower in pace, outside off, Gunaratne looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Outside off, eased through to cover.
Full on middle and off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off, defended to the leg side.
Full on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
There is the effect. Slower one, Asela goes back to cut but misses. The ball stays low as well.

FOUR! Nicely done. Full, flat and fast outside off, Gunaratne reaches out and steers it past short third man. Jasprit Bumrah starts to chase but then gives it up. Dhoni just asks Sundar to slow his pace a bit. Moves to 13 from 12 balls.

Full on middle, Gunaratne gets down and gently scoops this over the keeper. Safe shot, as neither short third man nor short fine leg were present. Two runs taken by the time Chahal could get across from fine leg. The stand moves to 11 from 15 balls.
Flighted ball, patted back to the bowler.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
In the air... but safe! Drifting in towards the pads, Gunaratne shapes for the big sweep but gets a top edge over the mid-wicket fielder and the ball falls down safely.
Spinning away, Asela clips it against the turn to mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish ball, turned around the corner for a run.
Leans forward and smothers the turn.
Spinning in, knocked to long on for a run.
Dabbed to short third man this time.
Tossed up ball, eased off the front foot to mid on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid on for a run.
Sundar returns.
Clipped to the leg side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Asela Gunaratne comes out to bat. He has returned after an injury. One of the bright stars for Sri Lanka, can he do something spectacular?

OUT! Chahal gets among the wickets as well. He bowls this one quicker and at a shorter length outside off. Gets it to skid after pitching. Dickwella rocks back and goes for a cut but ends up slicing it towards short third man. Sundar doesn't need to move an inch and takes a straightforward catch. End of the 53-run stand. The wheels are coming off for Sri Lanka.

FOUR! Easy pickings! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Dickwella crouches and sweeps it through short fine leg for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up as well while Dickwella goes past 1000 ODI runs.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Dickwella tries to clip it but misses.
Well outside off, Dickwella tries to guide it to third man but misses.
Short delivery, cut past point for a couple.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery, Mathews gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Camps back to the back of the length delivery and blocks it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

The on-air commentators make a good point on air. They compare the way Thirimanne and Dickwella played the reverse sweep. The former didn't kneel and went for the shot but missed it completely. It was also a not correct shot selection. However, Dickwella picked up the pace of the ball early and executed the reverse sweep nicely against Sundar. Shows how much sound technique means at the biggest stage.
Full delivery, driven to mid on.
Uses his feet to this one and blocks it.
Hardik Pandya comes back into the attack.
Kneels and reverse sweeps it nicely to short third man but straight to the fielder.
Change in field.
Drifting in with the arm, eased to mid on.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Kneels and plays the fancy reverse sweep towards point where Kumar dives to his left to make a partial stop. A run taken.
Sliding down the leg side, Mathews tucks it to short fine leg and takes off. There is a wayward throw from the fielder which allows the batsmen to take a run comfortably.
Tossed up delivery, eased to mid off.
Hangs back to the shortish delivery and blocks it. 11 from the over, a good one for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Fullish delivery on middle, Dickwella goes for the fancy reverse sweep and connects well. Gets it through short third man. Chahal hares after it but only comes second best.
Tries to go for another big hit but doesn't get underneath it that well. Heaves it over mid on for a run.
Tucked with the spin to mid-wicket.
SIX! Bang! Hit with authority. Fullish around off, not much turn on that one. Mathews frees his arms and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
Spinning into Mathews who tucks it to mid-wicket.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
FOUR! Sri Lanka need much more of these. Dickwella makes room and goes inside out over covers to pick up a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

An inquiry for a caught behind but there is no conviction behind the appeal. Quicker one down the leg side, Mathews looks to glance it but misses. Dhoni takes it and appeals. However, the umpire signals a wide. Rohit Sharma is not amused as the replays show that it went off the pad.
A bit quicker this time, tucked to mid-wicket.
Drifting in, flicked to mid on.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, clipped against the spin to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm over now.
Dickwella drives it to covers where Karthik dives to his left to make a good stop.
Mathews takes a couple of steps down the track and drives it through mid off for a run.
Stays leg side of the ball and strokes it through covers to rotate strike.
Full length ball, drilled to wide long on for a run.
Clipped with the angle through square leg for a single.
Dickwella steps down the track and Sundar bowls it full on middle, jammed out down the track in the end.
Time for Drinks.

FOUR! Misfield from the youngster! Short delivery on middle and leg, Mathews pulls it but miscues it a bit. The ball skies towards deep square leg. Sundar runs to his right, tries to stop it but overruns it. Concedes a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

An appeal for an LBW turned down! Fullish delivery around leg stump, Dickwella aims to clip it across but is hit on the pads. The Indians appeal but it is turned down. Bumrah himself indicates to Dhoni that it pitched outside leg and Dhoni has a smile about it. Replays show that he was right, good observation.
Tight run! On a length outside off, Mathews taps it towards covers and takes off. There is a shy at the striker's end which misses. Dickwella would have been safe though.
FOUR! Shot! Full length ball, Mathews leans into it and drives it through mid on for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fullish delivery, eased through covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! What a good shot to begin with! Dickwella skips down the track and takes it on the full to stroke it down the ground for a majestic boundary.
Niroshan Dickwella comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! First ODI wicket for Sundar. A big moment for the youngster and he has a big smile on his face. Thirimanne shapes for the fancy reverse sweep and spotting that, Sundar pushes it quicker through the air off on a full length. Smart thinking from the youngster and the southpaw misses it completely to get his stumps shattered. It did seem that the 18-year old will get the better of Thirimanne and that is what happened. His teammates encircle him to make this moment a memorable one.
A stifled appeal for an LBW denied. Coming in with the arm, Thirimanne makes room, uses his feet and tries to force it through covers but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, blocked watchfully.
Angling in appreciably, nudged off the hips to mid-wicket.
Hops in the crease to the good length ball and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Well-directed bouncer on off, Mathews sits under the bumper in a jiffy. Pandya has a knack of surprising the batsmen with the short ones.
Back of a length ball outside off, tapped past point for an easy run.
Good length ball on off, Mathews shuffles across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fullish in length, swept to the leg side for a run. 4 from Sundar's first over, a steady start to his international career.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slow through the air, patted through covers for a single.
Beautifully bowled! Tossed up outside off, drifting away. Mathews aims to clip it across but gets a leading edge towards point. A run taken.
Hangs back to the quicker delivery and keeps it out.
Slow through the air, eased off the front foot to covers for a run.
Washington Sundar to roll his arm over now. A big moment for the debutant. He is a very impressive player. Can he perform at the highest level as well?
Overpitched outside off, caressed to sweeper cover for a run.
Angling into Lahiru who clips it to mid on.
Strides forward to the fullish delivery and strokes it through covers for a single.
Back of a length outside off, flayed to sweeper cover for a run.
Poor shot! Full ball on off, Thirimanne kneels and goes for an agricultural slog over the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full length ball outside off, driven with the angle to covers.
On a length, Lahiru clips it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Thirimanne tries to glance it but misses.
Leans into the fullish delivery and taps it to mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Crisp! Shortish ball and width on offer, Mathews pounces on it and slaps it past point for a rocketing boundary. 50 up for Sri Lanka.
On a length, seaming in. Mathews covers the line and defends it solidly.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Tucks this with the angle to square leg for a run.

Not Out! Amazing piece of work from the stalwart though. Good length ball outside off, Mathews steers it off the outer half of the bat towards third man. The fielder gets across to the ball quickly as the batsmen attempt the second. Dhoni allows the ball to come to him but doesn't collect it as the ball hits the stumps. Has Mathews failed to make his crease? It is referred upstairs. No, he is comfortably in but what presence of mind from MS Dhoni.
Wow! Brilliant piece of glovework from Dhoni as the umpires go upstairs for a run out. However, he is not confident. Let's find out...
Hangs back to the back of the length delivery and stonewalls it.
On a good length around off, knocked to mid off.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders will be outside the 30-yard circle. Meanwhile, Hardik Pandya has a change of ends.
FOUR! Hit with disdain! Short delivery in line of the stumps, sits up nicely for Thirimanne. He stands tall and pulls it with command over mid-wicket to find the ropes.
Slower delivery at 107 clicks on leg stump, Lahiru aims to clip it away but is hit on the pads.
Short of a length outside off, punched firmly to sweeper cover for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Moves across his sticks and tucks it to mid-wicket for a swift run to get off the mark.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Almost another wicket! Good length ball well outside off, Thirimanne shuffles and tries to clip it across but the ball shoots off the deck. Ends up getting a leading edge that spoons towards covers but falls right in the gap between the two men out there and rolls through the inner ring. A couple taken.
Angling into Lahiru who tucks it through square leg for a brace.
Short and well outside off, cut straight to the man at point.
A play and a miss! On a length around off, Thirimanne makes room, skips down the track and tries to force it over covers but only connects with thin air.
Fuller in length outside off, takes off. Thirimanne prods forward to negotiate it but gets it off the outer half of the bat to Dhawan at gully.
Overpitched outside off, pushed to covers off the front foot.
On a length, jagging back in, tucked nicely to mid-wicket. End of a productive over for India.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Mathews has a poke at it and gets beaten. He was having trouble in that channel consistently. The Indians are bowling according to the plan.
Angelo Mathews strides out to the middle.

OUT! That's a really soft dismissal! Not an ideal delivery but Bumrah will be happy that he has got a wicket. Full length ball down the leg side, Gunathilaka aims to clip it behind square on the leg side but gets a faint nick instead. Dhoni moves to his right and accepts it gleefully. Umpire Reiffel raises his finger as well. The replays show that Bumrah's front foot was well behind the popping crease as opposed to in the first game where he got a wicket but overstepped. Nice adjustment made by him. Sri Lanka in deep trouble now.
On a length on middle and off, Danushka is squared up a touch in his stance but does well to keep it out.
Coming at a nice height to Thirimanne outside off as he plays it with an angled blade behind point for a run.
Jasprit Bumrah comes into the attack.
Fuller in length in line of the stumps, swinging down. Lahiru clips it though mid-wicket for a run and will retain strike.
Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, blocked with a straight bat.
On a length, the opener shuffles a touch and nudges it to mid-wicket for a run.
Leaving Thirimanne on a length, he makes good use of the depth of the crease and steers it to third man to rotate strike.
Hangs back to the back of a length delivery and pushes it nicely to the cover region.
On a length on middle and leg, punched nicely but straight to the man at mid on.
Short of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to covers.
Full length ball around off, Gunathilaka defends it with his bat and pad close together.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Good length ball on the pads, Danushka clips it nicely through mid-wicket. Chahal attacks the ball from the deep but the running between the wickets is good enough to complete the second.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Danushka is up to the ask and drives it nicely to mid on.
FOUR! Nicely done! That will give him some confidence. Fuller in length around off, Gunathilaka commits to it and lifts it over mid off for a two-bounce boundary.
Swinging in on a fullish length, played with soft hands to mid off. Only 4 from that over, a good one from Kumar.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

On a length, Gunathilaka punches it through cover-point. Iyer and Karthik give it a chase and it is the one with the young legs who reaches there first. Slides and parries it to his partner to save a run for his side.
Similar length ball around off, steered off the outer half of the bat to third man for a single.
Beautifully bowled! Good length ball on off, pitches and seams away appreciably. Thirimanne pokes at it and is beaten all ends up.
Swinging into Thirimanne who clips it with the angle to mid-wicket.
In line of the stumps, tucked to mid-wicket for a run.
Lahiru Thirimanne comes out to bat. He hasn't been among the runs. Can he do something brilliant today?

OUT! Pandya draws first blood! A poor stroke brings about the downfall of Tharanga. Shortish and wide outside off, Tharanga fishes at it away from his body and doesn't commit to it. Plays it with a circumspect approach and hence, mistimes it towards covers. Dinesh Karthik gets low to his left and takes a good catch. Ideal start for India.
Short ball on leg stump, pulled with command through square leg for a run.
Fuller in length, defended solidly off the front foot.
Similar length ball, good zip on that. Upul arches back and steers it to third man to rotate strike.

In the air... but safe! Back of a length ball around off, Tharanga goes for a pull but is not in a good position. Gets a top edge that lobs towards mid on. Bumrah runs ahead but the ball lands well short of him.
Fractionally overpitched on off, eased off the front foot to mid off.
On a length around the hips, Tharanga tucks it in front of square leg for a run.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short ball down the leg side, Tharanga help pulls it to the fine leg fence. Rare from Kumar, he is really accurate.
Back of a length ball, Upul hangs back and defends it stoutly.
Peach! Length delivery on off, seams away after pitching. Tharanga feels for it and is beaten.

Good fielding! On a length on middle and leg, Gunathilaka tucks it through mid-wicket. Sharma hares from mid on and slides near the fence to save a run for his side. He would have been stiff after his knock but that will loosen him up.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Tharanga pats it to mid on. End of a disciplined over.
Back of a length delivery, defended solidly off the back foot.
Length delivery around off, pushed with soft hands to cover-point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in length, Gunathilaka goes for a drive with hard hands but gets a bottom edge besides the pitch on the off side.
Fuller in length around off, Gunathilaka presses forward and defends it solidly.
Hardik Pandya to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. He didn't get it in the previous match. Let's see how he fares today.
Leg bye! Straying on the leg stump again, Gunathilaka aims for a clip but misses. The ball brushes his pads and rolls to fine leg as Bumrah mops it up. A run taken.
Around the hips, tucked around the corner for a run.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot to covers.
Wide! Down the leg side, Tharanga tries to flick but misses.

Dropped! A tough chance goes down. Good length delivery on off, shoots off after pitching. Tharanga gets in a tangle and tries to fend it off but the ball hits the shoulder of his bat and lobs up. Manish Pandey runs to his left from second slip, dives and gets his left hand to it but the ball hits his wrist and falls down.
On a driving length outside off, tantalizing one for the batsman. He resists the temptation to go for it and allows it through safely.
Sri Lanka are away! On a length on leg stump, Gunathilaka tucks it to square leg for an easy run to get off the mark.

We are back for Sri Lanka's reply with the bat. Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka to open the batting for them. They have no other option but to go after the bowling. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start off with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
